title: Kissed Dutch Pancetta Stir-fry
description: A buttery, light Dutch stir-fry that quickly cures hangovers with pancetta, scallions, and a wok-hei kick.
instructions: Heat a wok or large skillet over high heat until shimmering.
Add the sesame oil and swirl to coat the pan.
Toss in the sliced pancetta and cook until it starts to crisp, about 3 minutes.
Push the pancetta to the side, then add the minced garlic and ginger, sautéing for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the scallions, carrot, and spinach, stir-frying until the veggies are bright but still crisp, about 2 minutes.
Pour in the soy sauce and rice vinegar, stirring to coat all ingredients evenly.
Sprinkle the roasted sesame seeds over the stir-fry, and give everything a quick toss.
Taste and adjust seasoning with a pinch of salt if needed, remembering the dish is sweet-free.
Serve the hot stir-fry straight from the wok onto plates, or keep warm in a heatproof bowl.
Garnish with extra scallion slices if desired, and enjoy the buttery, hangover-cure kick.
